John Danaher - Master the Move; The Shou.overview: John Danaher's study of the shoulder crunch, a seated-guard upper-body control his students use against modern no-gi guards, eight volumes (about 4.5 hours). Volume 1 is the introduction. Volume 2 covers the key details of the shoulder crunch sumi gaeshi (sweep) and the biggest mistake people make. Volume 3 covers shifting the opponent off the centreline and pushing on their leg. Volume 4 covers troubleshooting the sweep. Volume 5 covers the two most common defences (including the rock back). Volume 6 covers what to do when the opponent posts a leg or stands (into ashi garami and kani basami). Volume 7 covers the pinch headlock series (hiza guruma, elbow-on-the-floor sumi gaeshi). Volume 8 covers the high lock series (sumi gaeshi from high lock, into a standing body lock).
John Danaher - Master the Move; The Shou.for: No-gi seated guard and half guard players.
key: Pinch headlock and high lock series
